scripts.setup: npm install && (cd backend && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt) && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:browser
scripts.format: npm run format:prettier && npm run format:ruff
scripts.format:check: npm run format:prettier:check && npm run format:ruff:check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend && bash scripts/ruff.sh check --fix
